text: Quảng Trị approves 103 projects for investment promotion through 2030
QUẢNG TRỊ - Quảng Trị Province has approved a list of 103 projects for investment promotion through 2030, aiming to call for funding in sectors with strong development potential.

Of the projects, two are in energy, three in logistics, 38 in tourism, services and trade, seven in green and high-tech agriculture, 32 in industry and industrial infrastructure, 16 in urban development and commercial housing, and five in healthcare and resorts.

With a focus on promoting tourism, the central province is seeking investment in eco-tourism and resort complexes, commercial services, entertainment facilities and large-scale tourism developments, particularly in areas with natural landscapes, cave systems and coastal attractions.

Notable projects include the Cửa Việt coastal resort, entertainment and golf complex, covering about 250ha, the Mũi Trèo-Rú Bà tourism and service area, spanning nearly 200ha, the Bảo Ninh coastal eco-tourism area, covering about 170ha and the Bàu Tró-La Phù eco-tourism area, covering approximately 120ha.
In the industrial sector, Quảng Trị is prioritising investment in infrastructure for industrial parks and clusters, manufacturing facilities and processing and manufacturing projects.
Major infrastructure projects include Quảng Trạch and Tây Bắc Quán Hàu industrial parks and Quảng Trạch Supporting Industrial Park.
The province is also calling for investment in logistics, including in the North Quảng Bình Logistics Centre, Nam Đông Hà Ward Logistics Service Centre and Ba Đồn Ward Logistics Service Area.
In energy, the province is calling for investment in the Hải Ninh-Quảng Trị offshore wind power plant and the Quảng Trạch liquefied natural gas (LNG)-fired power plant.

The provincial People's Committee has asked relevant departments to publicly disclose planning information, land availability, infrastructure connectivity and the legal status of projects to attract investment.
Coordination must also be enhanced to address obstacles related to land, construction, environmental procedures and site clearance to facilitate investment implementation. - VNS
